coverage.description: Process-scoped PresentMon capture using current documented CLI switches with deterministic per-PID CSV summarization.
known_gaps: frame summaries are evidence, not automatic performance budgets unless the runtime test declares performance assertions
hardware telemetry requires PresentMon/platform support beyond the baseline
real Windows/MO2 qualification is still required before release-gate trust
coverage.denominator_probe: target-process frames captured and summarized from the produced CSV.

safety.sandbox_or_scope: Capture is scoped to the fresh runtime process id; stale output CSV is removed before execution.

verification.output_readback: Composite MO2+DevBench sessions can launch PresentMon against the fresh DevBench-reported game PID; require target-PID rows and a usable frame-time metric before G20 evidence can pass.

ai.context_cost_notes: Turns raw frame CSV into compact typed evidence for runtime gates.
